claim_text: Looking ahead, our overall emissions are expected to decline in line with our decarbonisation implementation strategy.
context_text: Looking ahead, our overall emissions are expected to decline in line with our decarbonisation implementation strategy.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 这是一项前瞻性预期表述，不是报告期内已实现的历史绩效；报告未提供能够证明未来“expected to decline”已实现的实际数据，属于明显漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 未来预期，不得作为实际绩效证据。
